import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from statsmodels.stats.proportion import proportion_confint

def panel(ax, x, col, title):
    g = x.groupby("group")[col].agg(["sum", "size", "mean"])
    lo, hi = proportion_confint(g["sum"], g["size"], method="wilson")
    bars = ax.bar(np.arange(len(g))*5+2, g["mean"] * 100, yerr=[(g["mean"] - lo) * 100, (hi - g["mean"]) * 100],
                  capsize=6, color=["lightgray", "tab:blue"])
    ax.bar_label(bars, fmt="%.1f", padding=8)
    ax.set_xticks(np.arange(len(g))*5+2, g.index)
    ax.set_ylabel("%")
    ax.set_title(title)
    ax.spines[["top", "right"]].set_visible(False)

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(10, 3.8))
panel(axes[0], orders, "late", "Опозданий вдвое меньше")
panel(axes[1], ab[ab["distance_km"] < 2], "ordered", "До 2 км заказывают чуть реже")
fig.tight_layout()

import numpy as np

 g=data.groupby('group')[col].agg(['sum','size','mean']).iloc[::-1]
 low,high=proportion_confint(g['sum'],g['size'],method='wilson')
 pos=np.array([2,7])

 ax.vlines(pos,low*100,high*100)
 for p,v in zip(pos,g['mean']*100):ax.text(p,v+.8,f'{v:.1f}',ha='center')

name: numeric-spaced-points
code:
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from statsmodels.stats.proportion import proportion_confint

d = pd.read_csv("deliveries.csv")
ok = d[d["actual_min"].between(1, 299)].copy()
ok["late"] = ok["actual_min"] > ok["promised_min"]
g = ok.groupby("shop_id")["late"].agg(["sum", "size", "mean"]).sort_values("mean")
lo, hi = proportion_confint(g["sum"], g["size"], method="wilson")

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 3.5))
ax.errorbar(np.arange(len(g))*3+5, g["mean"], yerr=[g["mean"] - lo, hi - g["mean"]], fmt="o", capsize=4)
ax.set_ylabel("доля опозданий")
ax.set_title("Опоздания по кофейням с 95 % интервалами")
ax.set_xticks(np.arange(len(g))*3+5,g.index)
